title: Cloud Deploy: promotion between environments and approval gates

videos.script: An image in a registry helps nobody yet. It has to reach production, and in order. {{order}} Cloud Deploy carries one release through a list of environments. Each one is called a target. Here there are two, dev and prod. {{targets}} The release is rendered once, when it is created. The image is fixed by its digest. So what reaches prod is exactly what ran in dev. {{release}} Then the gate. Production waits for a person to approve. Promoting and approving are two different permissions. {{gate}} Rolling back is the same move, backwards. Nothing is rebuilt. {{rollback}} None of Cloud Deploy runs on a laptop. So you will read its files, and then watch two containers prove the one property it exists for. {{end}}
